title: Luxury Nashville - Rooftop, FireTable & City Views
description:
Discover the ultimate Nashville experience in this stunning house! This chic home offers breathtaking city views, 4 bedrooms, 4.5 bathrooms, and sleeps up to 12 guests. Enjoy a fully equipped kitchen, a designated glam station, and a prime location near Broadway and top attractions. Perfect for families, friends, and corporate retreats, your Nashville adventure awaits!

The space
Please note that there is a Gate around the entire complex (code will be given with checkin instructions).
Designated parking in a car port for 1 car only (9 ft. clearance). There is available street parking for any additional cars (please be sure to check street signs to avoid towing)!
